# paper-finder-student-mcp

> Search scholarly papers, find open access copies and related work through OpenAlex. No key needed. Free and open source MCP server for AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot and others).

## Setup
- Run with npx -y paper-finder-student-mcp
- No key or account. Optional OPENALEX_EMAIL for OpenAlex's polite pool.
- Papers are identified by DOI (10.xxxx/yyy) or OpenAlex id (W followed by digits).

## Data
- All results come from OpenAlex (https://openalex.org), a free open catalog of more than 250 million works, so the papers are real, not invented.
- Every tool reads OpenAlex directly, so there is no key needed and no account.

## Tools
- search_papers: query (required keywords), from_year (optional earliest publication year), open_access_only (optional, false by default), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8).
- get_paper: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807).
- get_paper_by_doi: doi (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539 or a doi.org link).
- find_open_access_pdf: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807).
- related_papers: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8).
- get_related_work: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8).
- cited_by: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8).
- list_author_papers: author (required, the name as it appears on the paper, for example Jane Doe), from_year (optional earliest publication year), open_access_only (optional, false by default), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8).

Each tool description states its inputs and one example prompt.
